notes.title: Update Description for "Gorgeous and Fantastic Battle" on March 27, 2022
notes.notes:

1. Add: third person camera mode can be selected, free mode or follow mode.
2. Add: When using the third person for the first time, a small window will pop up directly, and you can select the third person camera mode.
3. Add: Sound effects when a character falls.
4. Add: After eating in a tavern, a conversation appears and the food is very full.
5. Correction: When the entire staff is full of blood, eating in a tavern prompts not to eat.
6. Correction: Adjusted the speed of the actions of the skills "Thousand Mile Companion" and "Light Speed Cutting".

notes.title: Update Description for "Gorgeous and Fantastic Battle" on March 25th, 2022
notes.notes:
New: Button settings customization.
New: Settings interface, Molecular interface.
New: In third person, use the keypad to control the formation of a team.
New: Battle interface, you can also open the settings interface.
New: novice guide level, increased third person play guidance.
Correction: Time does not pause when captured.
Correction: Bookstore, skill attributes, display mount requirements.

notes.title: 2023.5.12 Update Description
notes.notes:
1. The first optional hero, Ollie's main class becomes a Double Axe Berserker.
2. The skill correction value of ordinary attack of two handed axe, two-handed sword and two handed spear is increased.
3. Skill "Double handed Axe Strike", skill correction value increased.
4. Once the big map enters a paused state, it will be changed to: only when the character starts moving or manually starts running will it enter the running state, rather than automatically running immediately.
5. Added mini maps for battlefield and plot modes, displaying map boundaries and character positions.

notes.title: 2023.5.9 Update Description
notes.notes:
Fixed bug: Gunfight, fixed the issue of continuously shooting at one place.
Fixed bug: Gunfight, the maximum teleportation distance is now limited.
Bug: third person, bitten by cannibals, fixed the wrong direction of the character.
Function correction: In the arena, the camera passes through a close-up wall, making it disappear to avoid blocking the view.
